journeys.name: /blog → post → back/hub nav
steps: Home click from post did not navigate

findings.title: Topics 'Read topic' on /topics/agents leads to /docs instead of reader
findings.observation: Clicking the 'Read topic' link (@e16) from /topics/agents navigated to /docs (documentation page) rather than /reader with topic filter. The topic page lists sources but the primary CTA does not handoff to reader as expected for 'agents' journey.
findings.impact: User journey from Topics/agents broken; users land in docs instead of content reader, confusing discovery flow.
findings.recommendation: Fix 'Read topic' link to target /reader?topic=agents (or appropriate filter). Ensure consistent handoff pattern matching search 'Continue in reader'.

findings.title: Docs page uses sidebar chrome breaking top-nav parity with home/reader
findings.observation: Navigating via header 'Docs' link lands on /docs which renders a sidebar layout ('Collapse Sidebar', docs TOC) and altered top nav (refs show Home after sidebar buttons, some items missing or in sidebar). Header is not identical to / or /reader.
findings.impact: Inconsistent chrome across site; docs feels like separate app section, users lose context of global nav when in docs.
findings.recommendation: Align docs layout to share the same header/nav component as hub/reader/search. Make sidebar additional/collapsible without replacing primary chrome. Or label as 'Docs mode'.

findings.title: Mobile menu click fails with strict mode violation due to duplicate link roles/texts
findings.observation: After opening mobile menu, clicking nav links like Topics/Sources resolved to 2 elements (one sm:hidden in header, one in content). Click using @ref failed.
findings.impact: Unreliable mobile navigation in automation and potentially flaky UX if ARIA not unique.
findings.recommendation: Ensure unique accessible names or use more specific selectors/data attrs for mobile menu items. Add aria-hidden or distinct labels for duplicated links.

findings.title: Mobile menu 'Toggle Menu' opens but no strong visual affordance for state or dismiss
findings.observation: Menu toggles to show full nav items, button shows [expanded]. But no backdrop, X icon change, or tap-outside clear in initial capture. Similar to prior W1 finding.
findings.recommendation: Enhance toggle to X on open, add scrim/backdrop, ensure escape key and outside click closes.

findings.title: Home nav link click from blog post page does not navigate
findings.observation: On /blog/hub-and-blog post, the header 'Home' link (@e2) was present in snapshot, but clicking it resulted in no navigation (stayed on post). '← Back to all posts' worked correctly to /blog.
findings.impact: Broken expectation for hub nav from deep blog post; users must use back link or other.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all header nav links (esp Home) are fully functional on blog post pages. Check event handlers or next/link usage in post layout.

findings.title: Some journeys rely on direct /goto or query params rather than pure UI clicks for entry
findings.observation: For stability used direct URLs e.g. /search?q=agent, /topics/agents. Pure UI from home via search button was not fully exercised (⌘K or fill).
findings.impact: Lower coverage of in-app search invocation and query propagation.
findings.recommendation: In future audits include snapshot after opening search palette and typing query to verify end-to-end.
